source: GBIF.org occurrence counts (live snapshot). Map tiles: GBIF occurrence density.
note: GBIF holds ~3.9 billion dated, located records of where life has been observed. Every record rolls up into one of eight kingdoms; ~14.5 M are identified only to 'life' (no kingdom). Coverage is wildly uneven — birds alone are the majority of animal records, a birdwatching effect, not because birds outnumber insects. Humans are recorded too (Homo sapiens), but GBIF restricts human occurrences for privacy, so despite 8 billion of us only tens of thousands of records exist.
